title: Niloufar Shadmehri, Iran's cultural Attaché, gave details about her deportation from France in a television interview.
text:
Niloufar Shadmehri, Iran's cultural Attaché, gave details about her deportation from France in a television interview."

""
"Niloufar Shadmehri, Iran's cultural Attache in France: "Two French diplomats committed a mistake in Iran and were quickly expelled. After some time, when they intended to return, they were stopped, meaning Iran would not allow them entry. Well, according to existing diplomatic laws, France, in a reciprocal action, wants two Iranian diplomats to leave France.""

"Niloufar Shadmehri, Iran's cultural Attache in France: "One of them is me [Deportee from France] , who was the cultural attaché, and another is Dr. Mohammadi Aghdam, who was our scientific attaché."

""
"Niloufar Shadmehri, Iran's cultural Attache in France: "These rules exist, and France could have exercised this right. Of course, we did not allow two diplomats to enter because they had committed violations; however, Dr. Mohammadi Aghdam and I absolutely committed no violations there. No illegal action was taken by us whatsoever. When I arrived at the airport, they happened to ask me about this, and I gave this exact answer. Because we are Iranians, and we Iranians know the etiquette of being a guest very well. The etiquette of being a guest in a country does not dictate that you engage in illegal behavior.
